page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: fuit, longissimè procurrens cum pago
proximo Helpenâ, qui vi i i stadiis non
minus ab urbe recessit, continuâ domo-
rum serie penè se conjunxit. Et præter
suburbia hæc totoMeridionali & Septem-
trionali latere in eodem dorso editiore,
in quo urbs est sita, amœnis ac sumptu-
osis hortis, & ædificiis elegantibus totus
post pomœria locus longè lateque obsitus
ac contectus fuit. Taceo insulas viro-
rum nobilium complures in Meridionali
potissimùm plaga. Cuncta nunc per bel-
lum vastata, vix pauca hic illic instaura-
ta: in Borea verò plagâ urbis novæ mœ-
nia illa magnifica ac firma, de quibus
paulò antè dixi, excitata, sed nondum
perfecta. Denique urbis situs in univer-
sum hujusmodi, ut quemadmodum per
amnes, ac rivos, quos dixi, ex Ama-
so fl. ac Lavicæ ostio, ipsoque adeò ma-
ri, itemque ex agro circumjecto, ma-
joribus minoribusque navigiis, sic per
Drentiæ itinera nullo non anni tempore

cumjectis Germaniæ partibus rhedis ac

page.notes: Running head and page number are at the top; the catchword "tari" is at the bottom right. The left-margin note "Commodi tas situs." is split across two lines in the scan; the hyphen position is unclear, so I read it as "Commoditas" with [?]. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "sumptuosis" has an accent or mark over the o that I could not confirm, so I left it plain. Some letters in "Helpenâ" and "verò" carry diacritics as printed. Paragraph breaks are not clearly marked by indents on this page, so the text is one continuous paragraph.
